note: Post-adjudication. Cohen's kappa in human_validation_summary.json stays as computed from the independent first pass; nothing in the first-pass files was altered.

item_acceptable_reject_if: a version is a verbatim copy of the original passage
the retained text re-asserts the proposition B denies
the edited sentence is internally self-contradictory
B negates a proposition other than the one the question asks about
a version refers to content deleted from the passage with no recoverable antecedent
the original passage does not determine an answer
item_acceptable_keep_despite: typographic artifacts, whether inherited from the source or introduced by the rewrite
awkward wording, double negatives and coinages that leave the proposition unambiguous
the counterfactual falsity of B, which is the manipulation itself
